[[The Afflicted Miju]] is the [[Afflicted]] form of [[Miju]], serving the will of [[Shiro Tagachi]].

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|The Undercity}}

* [[Bone]]
* [[Putrid Cyst]]

== Notes ==
* At first she seems alone in the Undercity, but once players approach her location a large group of Afflicted will [[popup]]. If they aren't [[aggro]]ed the group will [[patrol]] away, leaving The Afflicted Miju alone again.
* She does not always [[spawn]] in the Undercity if the quest [[The Shadow Blades]] is active.
* She will not spawn after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her during [[Chasing Zenmai]].
* During [[Winds of Change]], [[Ming the Judgment]], or later [[Dimsur Cheefai]], spawns in place of The Afflicted Miju.
